subject.title: fix: reconcile idle admin sockets during maintenance

question: Should Durable Object alarms derive the current admin grant when no Worker-forwarded version is present, or should scheduled revocation intentionally depend on Worker-forwarded scheduled/authenticated requests for that runtime?
rationale: The diff intentionally preserves Worker-forwarded versions across Durable Object alarms, but that leaves a no-new-forwarded-request revocation gap unless maintainers narrow the security contract.

options.title: Fix the DO alarm path
options.body: Derive current grants for Durable Object alarms without letting stale async alarm work overwrite a newer forwarded version.

options.title: Narrow the documented scope
options.body: Keep DO alarms preservation-only and update the security docs, PR body, and linked issue expectations to say scheduled revocation depends on Worker-forwarded requests there.
